title: 第24章 修仙六艺第25章 购买容器
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
不过林鹤清不知道这里的金丹期和他在蓝星里看的小说里的金丹期是不是一个东西，但是只要它能使得自己引气入体，真正进入修仙世界就好了。
林鹤清观察里面具体需要五六百年的样子，这果子果然有缘者得之，光长这么大就要五六百年的时间，真不容易。
一滴灵液能为树木加寿3年，那么应该要200滴左右。
林鹤清决定先在茅草屋后面的土地上种上那棵五枝树。
不在玉佩里种是因为不信任它，先得到一些五枝果，确保自己能够引气入体才最重要。
林鹤清用碗舀了一碗灵液，然后一点点地浇在树下，不敢一次性倒多了使得过了果子成熟的时机。
果树慢慢长出了第四根枝条，浇了好多，第五根枝条也慢慢长出来了，每个枝条上都开了几朵花，然后长出了果实，果实越来越大，越来越红。
林鹤清停下了手，数了一下果实的数量，一共有七个，不是每朵花开的地方都有果实。
然后一滴滴地浇上去，终于果实不再变红了，林鹤清停止了浇灵液。
他先摘下了一颗果子，擦了擦，坐下，直接一口咬下去，果子进肚子，一股热流由腹部传向全身。
林鹤清回忆口诀，按照口诀开始运行，热流带着林鹤清的气，走了一圈，林鹤清总算按照口诀里说的，走了一圈了。
林鹤清没有停下，而是借着这个劲接着走，直到热流不再，他才停下。
此时树上还有六个果子，手上还有一棵种子，林鹤清把种子收好。
手持玉简，闭上眼睛。
脑海里出现了一本书，书上引气入体篇翻过去了，出现了一个新的书页。
【练气期】
然后前面有一排亮着白色光点的文字，分别为“炼丹”、“驯兽”、“种植”、“制符”、“炼器”和“阵法”，分列两行。
林鹤清伸手去碰其中一个“种植”，这个是他现阶段最有可能做到的。
书本翻来新的一页，【炼气种植篇】。
“炼气期可种植一阶至三阶药材。所有植物皆有用途，种植第一件事，熟记药材种类及适宜生长环境。”

一阶至三阶植物。植物分十阶。
植物十年成材，一百年生长到极致，为一阶植物，现存大约四万种。
植物五十年成材，三百年生长到极致，为二阶植物，现存大约一万种。
植物一百年成材，五百年生长到极致，为三阶植物，现存大约一千种。
清灵界土壤适用于大部分植株生长，需得植物种子或有生命力的枝节。
法术：“化雨术”、“翻土术”、“移物术”（其他法术需此三法术练至熟练才可解封）
一大推知识进入林鹤清的脑袋，他的脑袋有点晕乎乎的，但是他看见上面有法术还是惊喜了一下。
其他的几个，林鹤清只稍微点进去看了一下，主要任务还是要先认识这一品植物那么多种，不至于有宝物在面前也不认识。
【炼气炼丹篇】
大部分炼气期炼丹用一阶植物，有少部分主药为二阶植物。
需勤练手法，有稳定火源，有丹方以及炼丹炉。
丹方：“辟谷丹”、“黄文丹”、“黄武丹”（其他丹药需此三种能熟练炼制后解封）
【炼气制符篇】
炼气期最多可制二阶符箓，超过灵气不足，不可成功。
content_en:
However, Lin Heqing didn't know if the golden elixir stage here was the same as the golden elixir stage in the novel he read in Blue Star, but it would be fine as long as it could allow him to draw Qi into his body and truly enter the world of cultivating immortals.
Lin Heqing observed that it would take five or six hundred years to achieve the fruit. Sure enough, those who are destined can get this fruit. It takes five or six hundred years to grow so big. It is not easy.
One drop of spiritual liquid can extend the life of a tree by 3 years, so it should be about 200 drops.
Lin Heqing decided to plant the five-branch tree on the land behind the thatched house first.
The reason why I don't plant it in Jade Perry is because I don't trust it. The most important thing is to get some Wuzhiguo first and make sure that I can draw Qi into my body.
Lin Heqing scooped up a bowl of spiritual liquid and poured it under the tree little by little. He did not dare to pour too much at once and make the fruit ripen later.
The fruit tree slowly grew a fourth branch. After watering a lot, the fifth branch also slowly grew. Several flowers bloomed on each branch, and then fruits grew. The fruits became bigger and bigger and redder.
Lin Heqing stopped and counted the number of fruits. There were seven in total. Not every place where the flowers bloomed had fruits.
Then he poured it on drop by drop. Finally, the fruit stopped turning red, and Lin Heqing stopped pouring the spiritual liquid.
He first picked a fruit, wiped it, sat down, and bit into it. The fruit entered his stomach, and a wave of heat spread from his abdomen to his whole body.
Lin Heqing recalled the formula and started to operate according to the formula. The heat flow carried Lin Heqing's energy and walked around in a circle. Lin Heqing finally walked around in accordance with the formula.
Lin Heqing did not stop, but continued walking with this strength. He did not stop until the heat flow stopped.
At this time, there were still six fruits on the tree and a seed in his hand. Lin Heqing collected the seeds.
Holding the jade slip in hand, close your eyes.
A book appeared in my mind. The chapter on "Introducing Qi into the Body" was turned over, and a new page appeared.
【Qi training period】
Then there is a row of words with white light spots in front, which are "alchemy", "animal taming", "planting", "talisman making", "weapon refining" and "formation", divided into two lines.
Lin Heqing reached out to touch one of the "plants". This is what he is most likely to do at this stage.
The book turns a new page, [Qi Refining and Planting Chapter].
"You can plant first-level to third-level medicinal materials during the Qi refining period. All plants have uses. The first thing to do when planting is to memorize the types of medicinal materials and the suitable growth environment."
First to third level plants. Plants are divided into ten levels.
Plants take ten years to mature and one hundred years to reach their peak growth. They are first-order plants, with about 40,000 species in existence.
Plants take fifty years to mature and three hundred years to reach their peak growth. They are second-level plants, with about 10,000 species in existence.
It takes one hundred years for a plant to become mature and five hundred years to reach its peak growth. It is a third-level plant, and there are about a thousand species in existence.
Qinglingjie soil is suitable for the growth of most plants, which requires plant seeds or viable branches.
Spells: "Rain Transformation", "Soil Turning", "Object Moving" (other spells require proficiency in these three spells before they can be unlocked)
A large amount of knowledge entered Lin Heqing's head. His head was a little dizzy, but he was still pleasantly surprised when he saw there were spells on it.
Lin Heqing only clicked in to take a look at the others. The main task was to first get to know the various plants of this type so as not to be unfamiliar with the treasures in front of him.
[Refining Qi and Refining Alchemy]
Most of the alchemy refining stages use first-level plants, and a small number of main medicines are second-level plants.
It requires diligent practice of techniques, a stable fire source, elixir recipes and an alchemy furnace.
Dan recipe: "Bigu Dan", "Huang Wen Dan", "Huang Wu Dan" (other elixirs need to be skilled in refining these three to unblock them)
[Refining Qi and Making Talismans]
During the Qi refining period, you can make up to the second-level talisman. If you exceed the level and there is insufficient spiritual energy, you will not be able to succeed.
